import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle, FancyArrowPatch
plt.xkcd()
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1,2, figsize=(10,4.5))
ax = axes[0]
ax.set_title("Plan 2.4x1.8m box, 2 rack rows, 50 crates")
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((0,0), 2.4, 1.8, fill=False, linewidth=2))
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((0.15,0.15), 0.9, 1.5, fill=False, linewidth=1.5))
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((1.35,0.15), 0.9, 1.5, fill=False, linewidth=1.5))
for i in range(5):
  for j in range(5):
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((0.17+i*0.175, 0.17+j*0.29), 0.15, 0.26, fill=False))
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((1.37+i*0.175, 0.17+j*0.29), 0.15, 0.26, fill=False))
ax.plot([1.05,1.05],[0.15,1.65],'--')
ax.text(0.3,1.7,'rack A 25 crates', fontsize=7)
ax.text(1.4,1.7,'rack B 25 crates', fontsize=7)
ax.text(0.9,-0.15,'2.40m ext, 900mm door at bottom', fontsize=8)
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((0.75,0), 0.9, 0.05, fill=False))
ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.set_xlim(-0.2,2.6); ax.set_ylim(-0.3,2.0)
ax.set_xlabel('length m'); ax.set_ylabel('width m')
ax2 = axes[1]
ax2.set_title("Section 2.0m high, rear evap high, return low")
ax2.add_patch(Rectangle((0,0), 2.4, 2.0, fill=False, linewidth=2))
ax2.add_patch(Rectangle((0.15,0.25), 0.9, 1.4, fill=False))
ax2.add_patch(Rectangle((1.35,0.25), 0.9, 1.4, fill=False))
ax2.add_patch(Rectangle((0.05,1.55), 0.25, 0.25, fill=False))
ax2.text(0.02,1.85,'evap', fontsize=8)
ax2.annotate('', xy=(1.2,1.6), xytext=(0.35,1.6), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->'))
ax2.annotate('', xy=(0.3,0.35), xytext=(1.2,0.35), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->'))
ax2.text(1.0,1.7,'cold fwd', fontsize=7); ax2.text(0.9,0.2,'warm return', fontsize=7)
ax2.text(0.9,-0.15,'25mm gaps, 900 door swing clear', fontsize=8)
ax2.set_aspect('equal'); ax2.set_xlim(-0.2,2.6); ax2.set_ylim(-0.3,2.2)
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig('sketch.png', dpi=150)
print('saved')
